items.item_text: High school diploma OR General Education Diploma (GED) required.
Clean driving record indicating no accidents within the past 6 months and no moving violations.
Ability to follow oral and written instructions.
Ability to recognize maintenance problems with company vehicles and perform routine maintenance.

Upholds Kaiser Permanentes Policies and Procedures, Principles of Responsibilities and applicable state, federal and local laws. Provides delivery service within assigned medical center by loading packaged merchandise onto vehicle; assures proper and secure placement of items to ensure safe and convenient delivery. May utilize equipment for loading and unloading such as pallet jack, dolly, and hydraulic lifter. Operates company vehicle in compliance with established procedures and the laws of the Motor Vehicle Code. Delivers merchandise to various medical center locations; obtains signature of receiving party for merchandise delivered and notes any discrepancies between amounts listed and received. Maintains delivery records/issues logs for items delivered to users or transferred between primary and secondary locations. Picks up, weighs and delivers clean and soiled linen (including doctors coats) and between facilities following established procedures. Picks up merchandise designated for return to storeroom; unloads returned merchandise. Inventories and completes accurate inventory records to maintain pre-established par levels. Stocks shelves for par replenishment. Inspects vehicle for any malfunctions. Checks oil, water and gas levels; checks tire for inflation. Performs other safety checks. Maintains maintenance records on vehicle and ensures cleanliness is maintained. Establishes and maintains courteous, cooperative relations with Health Plan members, the public, and other personnel. KP Service Standards: Follows LMPs ABCs: Takes Initiative: Positive first impression, ask how you can help and give information Take Responsibility: Solve problems, resolve conflict, assume ownership Take Care: Protect confidentiality, show respect, value differences, and show empathy Take Pride: Neat work area, low noise, be professional, support your team and KP. Performs other related duties as required.
Required to work every other weekend.
This is an on-call position, days and hours may vary.
